summary: Trihalo Accountancy is a small Parramatta CPA practice. Partner Edward Fang positions it around helping e-commerce businesses on Xero, and his LinkedIn pitch already claims 80% automated bank rec plus reconciliation of prepayments and supplier accounts. He was emailed on 23 Nov 2026. The firm sells automated reconciliation itself, so Vert has to be positioned as a complement rather than a replacement.

claims.text: Trihalo's website lists its address as Shop 7, 23 Hassall Street, Parramatta NSW 2150.
Edward Fang is listed on LinkedIn as a current Partner at Trihalo Accountancy (since Jan 2020), and as CPA Partner on the firm's site.
Edward's LinkedIn headline says he helps e-commerce businesses on Xero get their numbers fast, accurate and insightful.
claims.quote: I help E-Commerce businesses on Xero get their numbers fast, accurate and insightful

claims.text: Edward's LinkedIn About describes e-commerce clients with orders coming in from Shopify, Amazon and wholesale portals with wrong mappings.
claims.quote: Orders coming in from Shopify, Amazon, and wholesale portals with wrong mappings, AR with no chase cadence

claims.text: Edward's LinkedIn offer lists 80% automated bank rec.
His offer also lists reconciling prepayment and supplier accounts and matching sales and COGS journals in-month.
claims.quote: Sales and COGS journals matched in-month.

claims.text: Edward offers a Xero Health Check on every new client.
claims.quote: send you the Xero Health Check we run on every new client

claims.text: Trihalo's services page says it connects the client's stack and automates reconciliations once Xero is set up.
claims.quote: We connect your stack, automate reconciliations, and surface profitability by product, location, client or rep.

claims.text: Edward has worked for Big 4 firms as an external auditor and financial advisor for more than 10 years.
claims.quote: Edward has worked for Big 4 accounting firms as an external auditor and financial advisor for more than 10 years

claims.text: LinkedIn lists Trihalo Accountancy at 1-10 employees, founded in 2019, boutique in Parramatta CBD.
claims.quote: Trihalo Accountancy has 1-10 employees, founded in 2019.

claims.text: Trihalo's LinkedIn company page lists virtual CFO, business consulting and SMSF services alongside accounting and tax.

hooks.text: Edward's LinkedIn pitch targets e-commerce clients on Xero (Shopify, Amazon, wholesale portals), exactly Vert's multi-channel reconciliation territory.
He already automates 80% of bank rec; the remaining sales/COGS, prepayment and supplier reconciliations and the traceable-audit-trail angle are the gap Vert fills.
A Xero Health Check on every new client could include Vert as a delivery tool.

risks.text: Trihalo markets automated reconciliation and analytics itself, so could view Vert as a competitor or already have tooling.
Very small team (1-10 staff) and NSW-based.

gaps: No podcasts, articles or Facebook content found.
No tool names (Dext, A2X etc.) behind the 80% automated bank rec claim.
